candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `initialized=true;` so initialized remains false after a successful seedMarket call.
Change `initialized=true;` to `initialized=false;` so initialized stays false after seedMarket completes.
Invert the require condition so seeding requires marketDrugs != 0, meaning the first call reverts and never sets initialized to true.
Remove the require guard so any caller becomes the CEO, changing ceoAddress.
Replace the require's condition so any caller passes and becomes the CEO.
Delete the statement that adds newly produced kilos to Kilos[msg.sender], so Kilos never increases during collectDrugs.
Change the Kilos update from adding to subtracting newKilo, so Kilos decreases (or the call reverts) instead of increasing.
Replace the newKilo computation with the raw drugsUsed value, so the entire accumulated drug amount (not drugs/86400) is added to Kilos.
Insert a statement zeroing Kilos[msg.sender] at the end of the function, overriding the earlier accumulation.
Delete the statement resetting claimedDrugs[msg.sender] to 0, so the caller's claimedDrugs is not zeroed.
Delete the referral bonus statement, so claimedDrugs[referrals[msg.sender]] is never increased by the caller's drugsUsed.
Change the referral bonus divisor from 5 to 10 so claimedDrugs of the referrer receives half the bonus.
Replace setting claimedDrugs[msg.sender] to 0 with setting it to drugsUsed, so the caller's claimedDrugs is not zeroed after collection.
